World Series Champion Bob Boone Dies at 78

Bob Boone, a World Series champion and a member of Major League Baseball's first three-generation family of players, has died at the age of 78. Boone was a catcher for the Philadelphia Phillies and was part of the 1980 World Series-winning team.
